ruleDefinitions.name: Process Memory Dump Via Dotnet-Dump
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of "dotnet-dump" with the "collect" flag. The execution could indicate potential process dumping of critical processes such as LSASS.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\dotnet\\-dump\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "dotnet\-dump\.dll") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*collect.*"))
